order: Cut the fuel subsidy by a third.
Raise the sales tax by two points.
Launch a security operation against the Tehrik-i-Taliban in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
Expand cash transfers to poor households.
Open talks with tribal elders in Balochistan.
Nationalise the three largest private banks.
Increase development spending on roads in Sindh.
Cut income tax for salaried workers.
